rival_compete_blind_scale_023.text: Your prompt handling made our first set useful, Lin replied. The account got longer where the object demanded it. I can use that without pretending I had secretly designed your method all along. Qiu's smile appeared quickly and disappeared just as quickly. Lin had meant the acknowledgment precisely, but it carried warmth she had not planned. A rival's useful preference could become easier to hear when Lin stopped treating every sound quick answer as a challenge to her own worth.

rival_compete_blind_scale_024.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_scale_024.text: Jian asked whether the three instruments would return to ordinary use at once. Su answered that their owners would receive the cards and decide with the observed limits; the trial had no authority to certify every future task. Qiu helped tie each card without tightening the string against a moving part. Lin stayed at the rail and checked the written limits. They performed different small tasks toward the same handover. This did not settle whose method would be stronger beside a changing canal.

rival_compete_blind_scale_025.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_scale_025.text: As the last cover was folded, Lin looked once more at C's two separated lines. The direct-reference route had produced a prompt joint first set, and it had let both women learn where that set stopped supplying a sufficient answer. C remained unresolved rather than conquered. Qiu carried the empty weight box to Su's table, then returned to her own cup. Their rivalry had gained a more demanding possibility: a preferred method could be useful while still needing another question.

rival_compete_blind_touch_entry.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_entry.text: Lin selected the movement-history framing. Instead of beginning with the makers' marks or a single loaded position, they would observe approach, rest and return under the same small reference load. Su tied the three covers securely. Qiu would handle the trays in a fixed order; Lin would call the positions and elapsed rests from behind the cold rail. The method promised a richer account of behavior and demanded more time before the first simple answer. Qiu looked at the sandglass and accepted the demand.

rival_compete_blind_touch_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_touch_002.text: We should decide what movement counts before the pointers move. Qiu leaned over the unweighted faces without touching them. If every flicker becomes a sentence, we'll fill the page before one sandglass empties. If only the resting mark counts, the framing is false. Lin proposed three observations: first approach, settled reading at the agreed wait, and return after removal. Qiu added whether the pointer overshot the eventual position. Four questions could fit on a narrow card without pretending movement had only four possible meanings.

rival_compete_blind_touch_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_003.text: A rose smoothly, settled on the expected mark and returned promptly to its empty position. B rose smoothly, settled high and returned to an equally high empty position. C rose past its eventual mark, shook, drifted low and returned slowly. Qiu's hands supplied a consistent rhythm. Lin's slate captured the distinct histories. The first complete set took longer than a direct reading would have. It also distinguished B's steady offset from C's restless behavior without needing a second question to make the distinction visible.

rival_compete_blind_touch_004.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_touch_004.text: This makes B less alarming than its loaded mark alone. Lin checked the corresponding empty position. Its change under load matches A's at the reference weight. C is the one whose motion makes a single settled mark difficult to use. She felt a small satisfaction, then looked at Qiu. We have paid the history cost for A too, though A has given us no reason to need it yet. Qiu nodded. A's quiet success did not refund the time already spent observing it.

rival_compete_blind_touch_005.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_005.text: Su asked them to repeat the cycle with a shorter rest. A looked unchanged. B looked unchanged within the marks they could see. C had not finished settling when Lin called the agreed reading, so its apparent error shrank. The shortened wait made C look better rather than worse at the printed mark. Qiu laughed once, without amusement. A person hurrying could receive an encouraging number by interrupting a bad instrument before its less encouraging movement finished.

rival_compete_blind_touch_006.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_touch_006.text: I might have praised that shorter reading. Qiu kept her hand away from C's pan. Not because I wanted to hide anything. Because I expect a quicker return to the useful mark to be better. Here useful means merely near the mark for a moment. Lin underlined the wait in her record. The movement-history framing had exposed an attractive mistake in interpretation: a transient agreement could look like accuracy if the observer wanted a fast answer badly enough.

rival_compete_blind_touch_007.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_007.text: They restored the original wait. C drifted low again. Lin began to write a proposed cause, stopped halfway through the word, and erased the unfinished letters. A slow return might suggest friction, but a suggestion was not an observed repair. Qiu noticed the erased beginning and asked what she had almost written. Lin told her. Qiu asked Su whether the cover could come off to inspect the support. Su answered that identification and physical inspection came after the blind runs, as agreed.

rival_compete_blind_touch_008.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_touch_008.text: The cover is doing work even when it feels inconvenient. Su pointed to the unfinished note's clean space. If you see a patch, you may decide that patch caused everything you have observed. If you see a maker's stamp, you may decide your reading must be wrong. We can inspect later. For the blind set, describe the movement and leave its cause undetermined. Qiu accepted the boundary while looking distinctly impatient, which Lin found more credible than effortless approval.

rival_compete_blind_touch_009.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_009.text: On the third cycle, Lin miscalled B's empty position. She had followed the settled-load column down to the return line without shifting her eye left. Qiu heard the contradiction at once: Lin was describing a return below the visible pointer. She asked Lin to look again before Su copied the number. Lin corrected it. Their detailed card had exposed C's motion and created a small reading hazard of its own. More information required more disciplined movement through the page.

rival_compete_blind_touch_010.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_touch_010.text: The line needs room. Qiu pointed at the cramped four-question grid. You aren't slow because you failed to think hard enough. The positions are touching each other on the slate. Lin started to answer defensively, then stopped. The objection was to an actual surface, not to her competence. Su brought a larger slate from the table. Its cost was already within the facility's supplies; the women did not turn a better layout into a reward or a gift between rivals.

rival_compete_blind_touch_011.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_011.text: The larger spacing prevented the next column slip. It did not make writing four observations instantaneous. Qiu waited beside A while Lin completed the return line. She drummed no fingers and looked at no clock, but the waited time remained on Su's card. Lin could feel that honest silence becoming one of Qiu's strongest arguments. A method did not become economical because its opponents behaved courteously around its delays. The delay persisted, and the courtesy allowed its exact size to be seen.

rival_compete_blind_touch_012.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_touch_012.text: I want to keep the first card with the misread return noted, Lin said. She did not want the crowding itself to vanish into the improved layout. The larger card's usefulness was real because the earlier layout had failed. Qiu agreed, then asked that the four clean A cycles remain visible beside the C discussion. The record should show where their detailed procedure supplied no additional change, as well as where it exposed a variation. Lin added the A sequence without editorial apology.

rival_compete_blind_touch_013.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_013.text: Su covered the pointers briefly and changed the order of the trays. Their identities remained A, B and C on tied cards, but their positions along the table shifted. Qiu began to put the weight on the familiar middle tray, stopped, and read its tied label. C had moved there. The near error cost a pause. Lin had been watching the same middle position and would have recorded it as B if Qiu had carried on. Their fixed order had turned into a hidden identity shortcut.

rival_compete_blind_touch_014.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_touch_014.text: The movement history helps only if the history belongs to the right object. Qiu looked at Lin, then at the card she had finally read. A longer page doesn't solve my habit of reaching for the place where B was. It might make the wrong history look more convincing. Lin agreed. They announced each tray label before the weight was set. The added words slowed every run. This time the need for them arose from an actual near confusion rather than a general fear of error.

rival_compete_blind_touch_015.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_015.text: The shuffled set confirmed the earlier behaviors. A remained smooth and sound at the tested load. B retained its offset. C varied with repeated handling and returned slowly. Lin's spacious card now carried more secure identities and a fuller history. Qiu asked whether every subsequent quick use of A would need the entire cycle repeated. The question was difficult because the movement framing had genuinely earned its cost today. Lin answered that the trial did not determine a universal retest schedule.

rival_compete_blind_touch_016.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_touch_016.text: We can say when this history was observed and what changed during it. Lin wrote the date beside A's label. If nothing relevant changes, a user might reasonably read the current mark for the same small question. If the object is moved, struck, repaired, or asked about another load, this record may be inadequate. I don't want to make ordinary use hostage to our whole afternoon. I also don't want today's sound behavior sold as perpetual certainty.

rival_compete_blind_touch_017.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_017.text: Qiu took that answer seriously enough to ask which changes the record would require users to notice. Lin could not list every possible event. Su suggested a modest handover: the owners would receive the observations, including unresolved behavior, and determine their own permitted uses. The public trial had not been commissioned to write every future procedure. Lin felt the boundary release her from a kind of overresponsibility she had almost welcomed because it would keep her method permanently indispensable.

rival_compete_blind_touch_018.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_018.text: When the covers came off, B revealed its polished brasswork and maker's stamp. C revealed a patched support. A looked plain and worn. Lin's eye went straight to C's patch, and she almost nodded as though the visible repair explained the whole movement history. Qiu caught the impulse. It gives us something to inspect, she said. It doesn't yet give us the cause. Lin laughed softly at receiving her own earlier distinction back in the rival's impatient, accurate voice.

rival_compete_blind_touch_019.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_touch_019.text: I dislike waiting under covers. Qiu folded C's cloth square with sharp corners. I would have liked to inspect the patch first and decide how much time to spend. But I might then have watched the movement I expected rather than the movement we recorded. She placed the folded cloth beside the card. The admission did not transform her into a lover of long trials. It acknowledged one occasion when the constraint had prevented a tempting shortcut from directing the account too early.

rival_compete_blind_touch_020.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_touch_020.text: The movement framing caught an attractive transient reading, a slow return, a cramped-record miscall, and a near identity error after the trays moved. Su read each note at an ordinary pace. It also spent repeated observation time on a sound A and a stable B. There is no first-answer speed victory for Lin; the selected question required the extra cycle. There is a fuller behavior account, with costs we have measured and limits we have preserved.

rival_compete_blind_touch_021.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_021.text: Pei asked whether the fuller account made Lin the winner. Qiu waited instead of answering for her. Lin said it made the selected account fuller. She had been wrong about B's return once and nearly carried a history under the wrong label. Qiu had proposed the overshoot observation and caught both near confusions. The work did not belong to the person who had chosen its framing alone. Pei scratched his cheek, faced with another afternoon that declined to become a tidy duel.

rival_compete_blind_touch_022.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_touch_022.text: Your patience had a useful edge, Lin told Qiu after the spectators moved away. You let the time stay visible, and you didn't let me make every delay sound like proof of seriousness. Qiu answered that Lin had made C's brief agreement impossible to celebrate blindly. Both acknowledgments referred to actual work. Neither required the women to agree that their methods had become the same. The unresolved instrument lay between them, bearing a card too particular to serve as a trophy.

rival_compete_blind_touch_023.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_023.text: Jian read C's card and asked whether the slow return meant the instrument should be destroyed. Su answered no. The observed inconsistency supported further inspection and restricted confidence at the tested load; it did not prescribe destruction. Qiu added that a damaged or altered object might still have a use someone could establish, but today they had established none beyond the observations. Lin appreciated the refusal to make uncertainty demand a dramatic punishment merely so the public account could end decisively.

rival_compete_blind_touch_024.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_touch_024.text: I can lose an argument about time without losing my preference for economy, Qiu said. I think I needed to hear myself say that before the canal trial. Lin answered that she could defend a rich history without requiring every question to become one. Qiu's mouth curved. Tomorrow you may catch me forgetting. Tomorrow you may catch me adding three unnecessary lines, Lin replied. The exchange was neither a vow nor a reconciliation; it was permission to keep noticing one another's habits.

rival_compete_blind_touch_025.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_touch_025.text: They tied the larger C history to the tray and kept the crowded first card underneath it. The miscalled line remained marked as corrected before copying, not as an instrument reading that had actually occurred. Lin checked that distinction twice. Qiu checked the label above it once and caught a loose string that might have hidden the letter. Each woman supplied a different small repair to the final handover. The low-load afternoon ended with a fuller account and no cultivation gained.

rival_compete_blind_audit_entry.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_entry.text: The challenged-record framing gave each woman a different role before the covers opened. Qiu would produce a quick provisional reading for each instrument. Lin would choose one targeted challenge to that reading, using the same small reference load. Su would then reverse the roles for a second set. The framing did not promise a complete movement history. It promised that every concise answer would face a deliberate attempt to expose the most consequential assumption its author had left unstated.

rival_compete_blind_audit_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_audit_002.text: A useful challenge can be short, Qiu said. It doesn't become stronger because I must defend my entire character before I answer it. She set the first weight gently in A's pan. My provisional account is agreement at the printed reference mark. Lin asked what A did when the weight came off. Qiu removed it; A returned promptly to its starting position. The challenge added a little time and left the bounded account sound. Su kept the first reading and the check on one card.

rival_compete_blind_audit_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_003.text: For B, Qiu's provisional account was a high reading at the reference mark. Lin challenged the assumption that the high position represented an altered response to the load rather than a displaced empty position. Qiu removed the weight and B remained equally high. The change under load agreed with A at the tested weight. Qiu revised the account to a repeated offset, pending a repeat. The challenge had not humiliated a rival. It had replaced an imprecise interpretation with a more useful one.

rival_compete_blind_audit_004.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_audit_004.text: For C, I want the repeat before I ask for the cause. Lin watched the pointer rest low after a restless approach. Qiu lifted and replaced the small weight. C's second reading rested much nearer the expected mark. Su wrote both positions. The concise first account no longer described its observed behavior adequately. Qiu frowned at C, not at Lin. A challenge was satisfying when it answered a real uncertainty, but Lin knew the satisfaction could become a appetite for making every rival's answer fail.

rival_compete_blind_audit_005.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_005.text: Su reversed the roles without letting the women inspect the hidden identities. Lin gave a provisional account for A that included agreement and prompt return. Qiu challenged whether the account depended on the weight's placement at the center. They repeated the run with the weight slightly displaced within the safe pan. A gave the same reading within the visible marks. Lin's additional return statement had not answered Qiu's placement question; it had merely supplied more information around it.

rival_compete_blind_audit_006.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_audit_006.text: For B, does your offset stay after the instrument moves along the table? Qiu asked. Lin had been about to recite the repeated empty and loaded positions as though their repetition made the offset portable. Su shifted the tray gently to another marked place. B returned to the same high empty position and gave the same changed reading under load. The targeted check supported the bounded offset. It also cost time the provisional account had not disclosed as necessary for that new condition.

rival_compete_blind_audit_007.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_007.text: For C, Lin's provisional account named different readings on a repeat. Qiu challenged whether repeat number alone explained the variation. They let C rest through an agreed interval before another placement. The earlier low position returned. Lin crossed out no observation. She changed the interpretation to variation associated with handling and rest, source undetermined. Qiu had strengthened Lin's behavior account by rejecting a causal phrase Lin had found pleasantly concise. The challenge reached the thought hidden between two accurate numbers.

rival_compete_blind_audit_008.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_audit_008.text: You have each made one account narrower and another better supported. Su laid the six challenge cards in paired rows. The question now is how you select the next objection. A reader could challenge anything: another load, another day, another angle. We cannot perform every conceivable check. Pick the unresolved condition most likely to change the small task we have actually agreed to test, and say what remains outside it. Otherwise opposition can consume the whole afternoon without producing a usable answer.

rival_compete_blind_audit_009.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_009.text: Lin selected C's settling interval. Qiu selected B's visible offset label. They could test only one in the remaining blind time before the covers were scheduled to come off. The disagreement was substantive. Lin wanted to know when a C reading became an honest current observation. Qiu wanted to know whether a person receiving B's card would remember to use its offset rather than trust the printed mark. Both questions mattered to a later user; their concern for later use did not choose between them.

rival_compete_blind_audit_010.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_audit_010.text: We already know C is unresolved, Qiu said. More detail may improve its history without changing the recommendation to inspect further. B looks nearly useful now, which makes a missing label more likely to hurt a user. She spoke with a precision that frustrated Lin because it was not dismissive. Lin answered that a clean restriction on C's use also depended on describing the wait. Their rivalry had reached a choice between two meaningful improvements rather than between vigilance and neglect.

rival_compete_blind_audit_011.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_audit_011.text: Let the receiving reader try B. Lin made the concession after looking at C's paired lines again. Today's C account already says variable and unresolved. I want its wait described eventually, but I cannot honestly call the description essential to withholding confidence now. Qiu accepted the decision without a triumphant nod. Su wrote the unperformed C timing question at the bottom of its card. The chosen check would have a result; the unchosen question would retain its status as a question.

rival_compete_blind_audit_012.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_012.text: Jian received B's concise card with its empty and loaded positions. Su hid the instruments' identities again and asked her to report the change under the same reference weight. Jian looked at the printed face and said the high mark. The card's two positions were correct; the wording had not told her which quantity the user wanted. Qiu shut her eyes briefly. She had argued persuasively for a receiving check and had obtained exactly the failure her clean account had failed to anticipate.

rival_compete_blind_audit_013.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_audit_013.text: The card says offset but doesn't say which answer to use. Qiu opened her eyes and pointed to the label. That word helped me because I knew the question. It did not help Jian enough. Lin asked Jian what she had thought the card meant. Jian said it was a warning about the scale's age. The phrase sounded plausible to her. Qiu's objection to hidden assumptions had returned through her own favored short term, and she did not try to rescue it by blaming the reader's unfamiliarity.

rival_compete_blind_audit_014.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_014.text: They rewrote B's card as a pair of ordinary questions: where does it rest empty, and how far does it move under this weight? Jian answered those questions correctly. The new card was longer. It was also less dependent on a reader carrying the authors' technical interpretation. Qiu timed the receiving answer and found it quicker than the failed short-label answer had been after explanation. Economy could be measured at the receiving end rather than counted only by the number of words on the card.

rival_compete_blind_audit_015.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_audit_015.text: The short word made us feel concise while handing Jian the missing work. Lin said it softly enough not to make it a public rebuke. Qiu looked at the rewritten questions and agreed. Then she asked whether Lin's phrase variation associated with handling and rest would travel any better. Lin stared at C's card and laughed without pleasure. The phrasing had sounded carefully restrained to its author. A new reader might hear a causal claim in associated, or miss the unresolved condition entirely.

rival_compete_blind_audit_016.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_016.text: They had no blind time left for a full C receiving test. Su allowed them to rewrite the label as an instruction about confidence: the reading changed between these runs; its cause is unknown; do not use this trial to claim a stable value. That was clearer, but it was not a tested receiving success. Lin made sure the card said untested wording beside the rewrite. She had just seen how easily a good reason for revision could become an imagined demonstration that the revision worked.

rival_compete_blind_audit_017.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_audit_017.text: This is the last blind card. Su checked the paired rows. A received two different sound challenges. B's response survived movement, but its concise handover failed before revision. C varied with repeat and rest; its new wording has not received a reader test today. Each challenge pursued a condition related to the selected small question. We have left other loads, other days and causal repairs outside the account. Now the covers may come off without deciding these matters for us.

rival_compete_blind_audit_018.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_018.text: B revealed its polished stamp, C its patched support, and A its plain scratched base. Pei asked whether the challenges would have been different if the women had seen those identities. Qiu said probably. Lin said the visible patch might have led her toward a cause before she observed C's repeated positions. Su added that the covers had reduced some cues and left others, including face shapes and handling sounds. The trial was imperfectly blind, and the actual imperfection belonged in its account.

rival_compete_blind_audit_019.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_audit_019.text: I recognized the maker's style of B's pointer, Qiu admitted. I did not know the exact instrument. When you challenged its empty position, I expected the answer to excuse the high reading. It did, in part. That expectation still belongs beside the result. Lin was struck by the willingness to name a bias that had not visibly corrupted the numerical observation. Qiu wanted a rival's scrutiny enough to make another possible objection available when she could have kept it private.

rival_compete_blind_audit_020.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_020.text: Lin admitted that C's restless pointer had made her expect a damaged object under the cover. The patched support matched the expectation, but the match did not establish its cause. Qiu nodded. Both women had a story ready before the covers came off. Blinding had postponed the story's easiest visual evidence; it had not prevented them from making one. The paired cards preserved what each challenge actually changed, keeping their expectations from becoming the invisible author of every final recommendation.

rival_compete_blind_audit_021.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_audit_021.text: I enjoyed catching the word offset. Lin watched Jian tie her cup cloth. I enjoyed it more than was useful for a moment. Qiu answered that she had enjoyed making Lin abandon repeat number as a cause. The admissions might have become a cozy exchange of equal guilt. Lin resisted adding that both faults therefore canceled out. They did not. Each temptation had influenced a different choice, and the useful thing was to recognize when pleasure in an objection began choosing the next objection.

rival_compete_blind_audit_022.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_022.text: Qiu looked toward the gate before answering further. A rival who hunts only your mistakes is exhausting, she said. A rival who refuses to hunt any because she wants to be liked is useless. Lin could not improve that sentence by adding an elegant third category. She asked what Qiu preferred from her tomorrow. Qiu said to challenge the condition that would matter at the canal, and leave Qiu's temperament out of it unless it changed an actual reading.

rival_compete_blind_audit_023.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_audit_023.text: The adversarial framing did not produce a simple winner. Su stacked the cards in their observed order. It produced sound narrow answers, revised interpretations, one failed receiving label, and a clearer untested revision. Qiu supplied several decisive objections. Lin supplied several. Your work can be attributed without pretending equal contribution is guaranteed in every run. Tomorrow's water may make one objection much more useful than another. The account will still need to say which one, rather than reward symmetry for being pleasant.

rival_compete_blind_audit_024.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_024.text: The women prepared the handover in silence. Qiu kept B's failed label under the tested pair of questions. Lin marked C's untested rewrite without turning it into a failure. Su retained the paired challenge cards as facility trial evidence; the owners would receive copies appropriate to their instruments. No participant gained custody of an instrument through winning an argument about it. The small boundaries gave the rivalry somewhere firm to stand while its emotional edges remained less certain.

rival_compete_blind_audit_025.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_audit_025.text: You gave up the extra C timing test for a real reason, Qiu said. I think I would have described that as hesitation if I had seen you do it without hearing you think. Lin looked up. I think I would have described your short label as contempt for a reader if I had not watched you replace it. They did not apologize for imagined accusations. They let the imagined accusations expose how much evidence a judgment of another person ought to require.

rival_compete_blind_audit_026.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_audit_026.text: The last observer left with the three bounded accounts rather than a favorite woman's slogan. Qiu carried the covered trays to Su's side of the loggia, keeping them clear of the cold rail. Lin stayed seated while her shoulder rested and read the paired objections one more time. The challenged-record afternoon had made rivalry useful without making it harmless. Tomorrow they would have less time to ask elegant questions, and moving water would refuse to wait while they decided who had phrased the better objection.

rival_compete_blind_after_001.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_after_001.text: Su returned the covered trays to their owners after the observers had left. She kept the facility's cards and their failed versions together. The expense pouch remained on her side of the table, a source for cloth, copying and cleanup rather than a reward waiting to be divided. Lin watched Qiu straighten one loose cover before stepping away. The rival's neatness had stopped looking like a claim that everything should be simple. It was a preference whose benefits and costs she could now describe.

rival_compete_blind_after_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_after_002.text: I thought a public contest would make us speak more sharply, Qiu said beneath the loggia. It made me speak more exactly. The sharpness still came afterward, when I imagined people repeating an answer they liked and leaving the limits behind. Lin knew that imagined repetition. She sometimes wrote an extra paragraph against a future misreading no present reader had actually made. They stood with that shared worry without using it to declare that all their disagreements had been misunderstandings.

rival_compete_blind_after_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_after_003.text: We can't follow every sentence home with every listener. Lin looked toward the wet courtyard. We can give them a clear card and correct an actual false account if it comes back. Qiu said that leaving the sentence alone felt like abandoning work halfway. Lin answered that repeatedly guarding a result could become another way to claim possession of it. The idea displeased both women. Neither found it easy to let a fair observation belong to people who might still remember it unfairly.

rival_compete_blind_after_004.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_after_004.text: Jian reappeared in the gate carrying the forgotten cup cloth. She thanked them for an afternoon she had found surprisingly interesting and said she still preferred a scale whose number meant what it appeared to mean. Qiu laughed. That preference was reasonable. Lin told her that a complicated record did not make the object more convenient. Jian nodded, accepting both the account and her annoyance. She did not have to admire the women in order to understand the limits they had established.

rival_compete_blind_after_005.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_after_005.text: Tomorrow's reading is at the rain-gauge station, Su said. We remain on the dry platform and its cold rail. You will compare observations of changing water and a small set of handed-over reading cards. No one enters the channel. The arranged disturbances alter cards and display markers, not the river or the working gauge. If the weather makes the platform unsuitable, the afternoon stops. We are conducting a low-load trial, not proving courage by borrowing danger from a real flood.

rival_compete_blind_after_006.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_after_006.text: The rain continued through the evening but weakened before dawn. When Lin arrived at the station the next afternoon, the channel carried a deeper brown flow beneath its usual banks. Su checked the dry platform, the handrail and the ordinary exit before inviting either participant in. Qiu stood at the far end with her sleeves secured. She did not make a virtue of being first. Lin sat on the near stool, her shoulder supported, and looked at the fixed gauge from the safe side.

rival_compete_blind_after_007.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_after_007.text: Moving water makes a clean number old almost at once. Qiu spoke without looking away from the channel. Yesterday we could repeat a load and compare its return. Today a later reading may disagree because the world changed, not because someone read badly. Lin nodded. That distinction offered speed an obvious advantage: a prompt number could remain useful longer. It also offered recoverability a harder task: an old correct reading had to stay identifiable as old, rather than competing with the current water.

rival_compete_blind_after_008.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_after_008.text: Our public recommendation is limited to this trial platform's display. Su pointed at a small board where observers would see the readings. We may keep the board showing one current value, show a range, or take it down while we resolve an uncertainty. These are practice display decisions, not channel orders or promises of safe travel. The fixed gauge remains managed by its ordinary keeper. We will neither move it nor treat this elective afternoon as authority over anyone's livelihood.

rival_compete_blind_after_009.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_after_009.text: The first water line was easy to see. Lin could read it from the rail without standing. Qiu could see it from a second safe angle. The keeper, an older man named Bao, had already made his ordinary entry and stayed at his own workbench. Su would use copies of his entry for one arranged card disturbance. Bao had agreed to the trial and would keep its practice cards distinct from his working record. His presence did not make either rival his assistant or successor.

rival_compete_blind_after_010.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_after_010.text: I will read yesterday's selected question once before we choose today's approach. Su set the blinded-instrument card on the dry table. An account can become too long for a changing world, too short for a later reader, or too confident about what an instrument actually identifies. The river will give us a fresh condition. We should bring yesterday's particular observation to it, rather than borrowing a slogan about speed, history or challenge.

rival_compete_blind_recall.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_recall.text: Qiu watched a twig turn in the near current. Lin watched the waterline mark and the chalk beside her slate. Both women were tempted to make the third afternoon settle the first two. The temptation gave the ordinary platform a theatrical importance it had not earned. Su's reminder interrupted it. A trial beside changing water could answer a narrower and more useful question: which chosen method would keep this modest public display honest during the time they actually observed it.

rival_compete_blind_scale_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_scale_cb_001.text: Yesterday you chose direct-reference checks. Qiu's handling and Lin's calls produced a prompt valid initial set. A agreed at the tested load, B showed a repeated offset, and C varied under repeat and rest without an established cause. Lin's separated lines preserved C's changed behavior. You did not test all loads or repair the instruments. Today a prompt observation may be valuable, but a repeated number can mean the water stayed still, the interval was too short, or the reading copied an older line.

rival_compete_blind_scale_cb_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_scale_cb_002.text: I want to keep the narrow first answer narrow. Qiu pointed toward the gauge. If I can see the present waterline clearly, I should not have to defend every earlier flow before calling it. But I will put the time beside it. C taught me how a sound-looking mark can borrow agreement from the moment when we happen to look. The river's movement gives that problem a new shape even when the gauge itself is working ordinarily.

rival_compete_blind_scale_cb_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_scale_cb_003.text: I want old and current lines separated. Lin touched the dry slate's upper corner. Yesterday one line would have hidden C's variation. Here a pile of lines could hide which one belongs to this minute. I won't pretend the fuller pile solves its own reading problem. Qiu glanced toward her and nodded. The women had not traded methods. Each was bringing a correction made within her own preference, which might make the next disagreement harder and more useful.

rival_compete_blind_touch_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_touch_cb_001.text: Yesterday you chose movement history. The record exposed C's transient agreement and slow return. The crowded first card led Lin to miscall a position; changed tray order nearly attached history to the wrong object, before Qiu stopped. Fuller behavior came with time and reading costs, including repeated observation of a sound A. Today history matters because water changes, but the record must keep the current line clear and identify the same fixed gauge on every entry.

rival_compete_blind_touch_cb_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_touch_cb_002.text: I will not use the covered history as a reason to delay every present call. Qiu looked along the dry platform. Water may make a later perfect account less useful than an earlier bounded one. I will also not pretend your wait was wasted yesterday merely because A behaved. C's transient agreement was an observation I would have liked too much. The question now is which wait tells us something about this water before the world moves again.

rival_compete_blind_touch_cb_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_touch_cb_003.text: I want the gauge named and the latest line separate from its history. Lin drew an empty current box, leaving the lower part of the slate blank. Yesterday the history nearly traveled under the wrong tray label. Here the station itself looks fixed enough to invite the same habit. I will name the sightline too. Qiu studied the box and said its size was good. A useful history did not need to compete visually with the present reading it supported.

rival_compete_blind_audit_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_audit_cb_001.text: Yesterday you chose targeted challenges. Both women supplied consequential objections. B's concise handover failed Jian until ordinary questions replaced its short label. C's revised wording remained untested; several causes and conditions stayed outside the trial. Today a challenge must address a condition that could alter the platform display during this afternoon. An elegant objection about every possible flood would consume the chosen time without deciding what this particular board may honestly show.

rival_compete_blind_audit_cb_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_blind_audit_cb_002.text: I want one objection tied to the current call, Qiu said. If I say the waterline is here now, ask whether this angle or the old card changed my reading. Don't ask me to prove that the whole channel will stay kind until sunset. She looked at Lin with a faint smile. I may get cross if you do. Lin answered that a current call needed its time and its scope even when no one asked for a prediction.

rival_compete_blind_audit_cb_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_blind_audit_cb_003.text: I will ask the objection that could change this display. Lin looked at Bao's distinct working record, then at their blank practice cards. Yesterday our short label gave Jian the missing work. Today a beautiful question might give Su the same missing work if it never reaches a display decision. Qiu's smile disappeared into concentration. Their challenge method had become more difficult: the chosen objection had to lead somewhere within the bounded afternoon rather than merely expose an assumption.

rival_compete_flood_early_entry.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_entry.text: Lin chose prompt sampling, giving Qiu the lead on current calls. Su sounded the bell only after the platform's display board had been turned toward the observers. Qiu called the fixed gauge and the time, Lin repeated both, and Su wrote the current value in the board's upper box. The first number was clear. Qiu made another call after the agreed short interval. The water had risen slightly. Their display changed while the first value was still fresh in every listener's memory.

rival_compete_flood_early_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_early_002.text: Present waterline, present time, this gauge from this rail. Qiu spoke the same compact frame on the next call. Lin wrote the line below her current box and copied the new value into the box. The repetition was economical without being bare. It gave a later reader three facts by which to recognize a current observation. Su handed Jian a practice card from Bao's earlier ordinary entry, keeping it plainly separate from his working record. The arranged handover disturbance had begun.

rival_compete_flood_early_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_003.text: Jian read the older value as though it belonged to the current display. Qiu stopped her before she finished the sentence. That card's time is earlier. Our present line is this one. The correction took only a breath. Lin felt pleased to see a fast method catch an old reading without a full review, then noticed that Qiu's attention had been divided between the gauge and the reader. Her next current call came a little late because the short handover interruption had occupied the interval.

rival_compete_flood_early_004.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_early_004.text: Our display is current as of the last call, not current by magic while we explain the card. Lin marked the late interval below her box. Qiu agreed at once. The waterline had continued rising during the correction. Su changed the display's time before changing its number, showing the observers that a gap existed. The board's honesty now included the age of its own answer. A precise timestamp could reveal a lapse rather than merely make a number appear more trustworthy.

rival_compete_flood_early_005.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_005.text: Three more prompt calls rose by small, similar amounts. Pei began saying the water was rising steadily. Qiu almost echoed the phrase, then narrowed it to the observed intervals. Lin could hear how attractive steady sounded beside an orderly series. It transformed a handful of lines into a mild prediction. Qiu kept the present call compact, but neither woman had yet watched long enough to know whether the series would continue. The display remained an account of readings, not a promise about the channel.

rival_compete_flood_early_006.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_early_006.text: The next card disturbance changes a copied digit, Su said after moving their private slate out of Jian's view. It does not change Bao's record or the gauge. She handed Jian two practice cards, one faithful and one deliberately altered. The paper itself was clean and looked equally official in both cases. Qiu could answer quickly by looking at the current water. Lin could answer historically by comparing the source copy's time. The chosen framing favored the present, and the trial would keep the old card question separate.

rival_compete_flood_early_007.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_007.text: Jian offered the altered older value. Qiu rejected it because it disagreed substantially with the visible present line. She could not say whether the older card had been wrong at its stated time. Lin wanted to establish that immediately, then remembered the selected question. She wrote disputed older practice copy beside the card and kept the current call moving. Their prompt display survived. The older source discrepancy remained unresolved, a loss of historical knowledge rather than a failure to see the water now.

rival_compete_flood_early_008.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_early_008.text: I can tell you what I see now. Qiu's next call was clean. I cannot use the present line to prove the earlier copy false. She directed that second sentence toward Pei, who had started congratulating her on detecting Su's altered digit. Lin appreciated the correction. The fast method's real strength did not need the added fiction that present evidence could settle any past value. Qiu was protecting the narrow victory from applause that would have made it less defensible.

rival_compete_flood_early_009.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_009.text: A pulse of driftwood approached the station and the waterline rose more sharply across two short intervals. Qiu called both changes promptly. Su replaced the displayed current value each time. Lin's lower history showed the increasing increments, but Qiu had noticed the change by sight first. For several minutes her speed was decisively useful. The observers received a current board without waiting for a longer consensus. Lin had no honest reason to slow the display merely to give her own careful method a more flattering role.

rival_compete_flood_early_010.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_early_010.text: Your interval catches this turn well. Lin spoke while Qiu drank between calls. The credit referred to the actual turning rise, not to every future flood. Qiu nodded and kept her eye on the gauge. Lin's shoulder began to ache from leaning her head forward rather than from any load. She corrected her posture, moved the slate closer with her sound hand, and left the next call to Qiu. The trial's physical limit remained in place even when the fast water made concentration feel urgent.

rival_compete_flood_early_011.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_011.text: The rise then slowed. Qiu called two nearly identical marks and said nearly holding. Lin asked whether the phrase meant the latest two observations or an expected plateau. Qiu answered latest two. Su put those words beneath the display. The qualification cost them a little time and protected a subtle boundary. The river did not care about their careful phrasing, yet people listening to a confident current caller might borrow a prediction from her tone even when her number was perfectly accurate.

rival_compete_flood_early_012.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_012.text: At the next interval, Qiu read a dark wet line left just above the present surface. From her angle, the retreating water and the old stain nearly joined. She called the higher mark. Lin looked from the near rail, saw the moving surface below it, and held the readback. Qiu shifted her head without leaning beyond the safe rail. The lower moving edge became clear. She corrected the value, and Su left the mistaken provisional call visible on the private card.

rival_compete_flood_early_013.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_early_013.text: The stain was current a little earlier and looked current to me now. Qiu spoke with a sudden hardness directed at herself. Lin asked her not to widen the error. The angle confused one call; it did not make every earlier observation false. Qiu inhaled, then repeated the corrected current value with its time and sightline. Her method had lost a point it could not recover by being generally skilled. It could recover the present display by making the local correction clearly.

rival_compete_flood_early_014.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_early_014.text: One provisional current call used the wet stain rather than the moving surface. Su kept her voice level. Lin's second angle caught it before the board changed. The board therefore retained its last valid value until the corrected call arrived. This is an actual prevented display error. It is also a gap in the rapid sequence. A safety claim about the whole channel is still outside this trial, and no listener should turn the avoided board mistake into one.

rival_compete_flood_early_015.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_015.text: Qiu's next two readings were slower because she checked the moving edge at both angles. Lin could hear the extra pause before the number. Su recorded it. The speed method had acquired a targeted check from an actual failure, and its new pace belonged on the same card as its old pace. Lin resisted feeling that the added check made the method hers. It was Qiu's correction to Qiu's call, prompted by Lin's observation, and that precise authorship was enough.

rival_compete_flood_early_016.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_early_016.text: The fast answer worked where the current edge was distinct. Lin marked the stain-confused interval. The second angle becomes worth its time when the edge retreats through its own mark. Qiu glanced at the note and said she would prefer that condition written on the public account. Lin did so. They had found a particular place where the environment changed the cost of reliable speed. It was more useful than announcing that haste always failed beside water.

rival_compete_flood_early_017.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_017.text: The corrected sequence showed the water falling gently over the remaining intervals. They had observed the turn without establishing its full crest. One interval had been missed during the card correction and another prolonged by the stain dispute. Bao's ordinary working record might contain additional observations, but the women did not borrow them silently to complete their own trial. Su left their peak value labeled highest observed in this sequence. A sequence could be prompt and still contain a gap large enough to matter to its historical claim.

rival_compete_flood_early_018.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_early_018.text: I want highest observed left as it is. Qiu stood beside the dry table and watched the falling water. Calling it the crest would make the afternoon feel finished, but we didn't see continuously. Lin nodded. Qiu's insistence cost her the grander version of the fast-method victory. It preserved the real version: prompt readings had kept the display useful during the rise, while a second sightline prevented a retreating-stain error before it reached the board.

rival_compete_flood_early_019.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_019.text: Jian asked about the altered practice card again. Lin said they had retained the discrepancy but had not compared its earlier source in this framing. Qiu offered to look now; Su checked the bell and said the chosen observation time had ended. They could leave a future question for another session. Qiu lowered her hand from the card. The restraint felt harder than an ordinary correction. An unfinished object invited them to buy a cleaner conclusion with time they had not agreed to spend.

rival_compete_flood_early_020.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_early_020.text: Prompt sampling kept a useful current display through the observed rise. Su covered the board after reading its final time. Qiu led the pace. One old-card interruption delayed a call, one stain-confused provisional value required Lin's second angle, and two gaps prevented a claim to the exact crest. The copied older discrepancy remains unresolved in this route. These are the observed gains and losses. The trial's current board comes down now because its last time is becoming old.

rival_compete_flood_early_021.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_021.text: The board disappeared from public view while the fixed gauge remained visible for its ordinary keeper. Lin found the separation calming. Their afternoon did not have to become a permanent service simply because people had watched it. Qiu rubbed her hands together against the cool air and asked Su to keep the late intervals legible in the final account. She did not want a polished sequence made from only her sound calls. That request made her speed feel more, rather than less, formidable.

rival_compete_flood_early_022.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_early_022.text: I would trust your prompt call within the frame you used. Lin spoke as they stepped back from the display. I would still ask the second angle when the water retreats through a wet mark. Qiu answered that the condition was fair. She did not demand a larger statement of confidence. The exchange gave their rivalry a bounded practical form: Lin could rely on a particular strength and still retain a question that had already prevented an actual wrong answer.

rival_compete_flood_early_023.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_early_023.text: You caught the edge while I caught the old timestamp. Qiu glanced toward the covered practice cards. I don't want that made into a perfect pair. We left the old digit unresolved and missed intervals. Lin agreed. The desire to become a splendid team could erase losses as readily as the desire to become the splendid winner. Their useful complement had existed in certain minutes, with certain gaps, and it was enough to say so without turning it into a legend.

rival_compete_flood_early_024.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_early_024.text: When Su sounded the closing bell, Qiu was still looking at the moving line. She turned away promptly, respecting the end she had requested at the start of the first afternoon. Lin stayed seated until her shoulder settled, then rose through the ordinary gate in the rail. The rapid-water route had let her rival excel and had given Lin one decisive correction. It left an unfinished old copy and an incomplete crest history behind them, where the final account would have to keep them.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_entry.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_entry.text: The corroborated-reading framing gave Lin and Qiu independent cards. Each would call the gauge from her own safe sightline, with the time recorded before comparison. Su would put a value on the practice board only when the two calls agreed or a named discrepancy had been resolved. The arrangement slowed the first display. It also made disagreement an object they could inspect rather than a tone one woman had to challenge in front of observers. Qiu checked the clock and began without protest.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_consensus_002.text: My line is ready. Qiu held her card face down until Lin finished. The brief concealment prevented either observer from adjusting toward the other's confident voice. Lin's reading matched within the visible marks. Su displayed the agreed value and the later of the two call times. The water had risen a little during comparison. The board therefore reported a recent observation rather than pretending the number remained exactly present. A sound consensus could age while becoming sound.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_consensus_003.text: We need the interval between our calls on the card. Lin noticed that her own writing took longer than Qiu's spoken call. They might agree only because the water changed too little to expose the gap. She added the times separately. Qiu welcomed the addition, then pointed out that the public board should not imply both readings occurred at the later time. Su wrote two readings in this interval below the value. The phrase made their slower method's temporal shape visible.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_004.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_004.text: The second independent pair disagreed by one visible division. Qiu called the upper mark; Lin called the lower moving edge. Neither card supplied enough information to decide whether the water had changed between them. Su withheld the new board value. The old value stayed visible with its old time. A neighbor asked why they were taking so long over a small difference. Lin could feel the pressure to choose the most plausible number and release the crowd from their procedural wait.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_005.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_consensus_005.text: Let's look together once, Qiu said. That would resolve the present display but end independence for that call. Lin agreed and named the change. Both women now saw the lower moving edge beneath a darker wet stain. Qiu's earlier angle had favored the stain. They corrected the provisional upper call and displayed the current lower value. The consensus method had caught the discrepancy before the board changed, but its independent procedure had not answered the cause without becoming a shared inspection.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_006.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_006.text: Su kept the paired cards beside the shared-inspection note. Lin wanted to call the episode proof that independent readings were safer. Qiu asked how much the resulting board had aged. The question was fair. During the discrepancy, the waterline had moved enough that their old displayed value became visibly obsolete. Consensus had protected against one wrong new number by leaving an older number in view. They would need a better way to show a pending disagreement rather than let silence make the old board look current.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_007.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_consensus_007.text: Take the old value down while we resolve a discrepancy. Lin pointed to the board's hinged cover. Qiu asked whether every tiny difference would then leave observers with no number. Lin paused. She had proposed an honest blank but had not answered its cost. They agreed to keep the old line under its explicit time while adding pending new reading above it. A listener could still see their last valid observation and know that it was no longer their current claim.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_008.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_008.text: The next two independent pairs agreed. Qiu's current call arrived sooner, Lin's written call carried the clearer sightline note, and Su's comparison took a measurable interval. The board advanced in small steps. Meanwhile the water rose faster. Their method could confirm each displayed value while supplying fewer displayed values than prompt sampling would have supplied. Lin's method had a real advantage at the stain and a real disadvantage in cadence. Neither advantage changed simply because she felt the procedure belonged more naturally to her.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_009.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_consensus_009.text: The first arranged card disturbance is an old time. Su gave Jian a practice copy of Bao's earlier entry and asked her to read it between the rivals' current cards. Jian offered the older value as a third corroboration. Qiu rejected it immediately by its time. Lin marked it historical rather than false. The copied number might be accurate for its own moment, but it could not resolve a present disagreement. Three pieces of paper did not become three independent observations merely because three people held them.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_010.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_consensus_010.text: We mustn't call her third voice independent if it carries Bao's earlier line. Qiu looked toward Jian, who nodded readily. That is a copy with a source, not a fresh sightline. Lin agreed. The consent of several readers could make a copied error seem especially secure. Their selected corroboration needed independence of observation and compatible times, not an audience voting on a comfortable number. Qiu's speed at tracing the card's source prevented the slower framing from granting it inappropriate weight.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_011.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_011.text: Su introduced a copied digit error on the next practice card. Lin compared the card with the retained faithful copy and identified the altered digit. Qiu kept watching the current gauge while Lin did the comparison. Their roles temporarily ceased to be independent current observers, and Su withheld the new consensus display. The old-copy correction succeeded. It cost one current pair. Lin could point to the historical repair as a benefit only if she also pointed to the missing present observation beside it.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_012.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_consensus_012.text: This practice copy's digit is wrong against its retained source. Lin set both copies flat where Jian could inspect them. I can correct that copy. I cannot say the source's older value is a present waterline, and I cannot fill the current interval we did not observe independently. Qiu called the present line alone, keeping it on her private card. Su noted the solo value without putting it on a board governed by the selected two-observer rule.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_013.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_013.text: The solitary line would later show that Qiu had seen the water rising sharply during the copy correction. It did not count as their agreed public value. Lin disliked leaving useful present information private merely to preserve the framing's rule. Su offered a choice within the remaining time: keep the two-observer rule, or change openly to a provisional solo display labeled as such. Lin asked Qiu which question the current evidence still needed. Qiu answered that they should keep the selected comparison and record its cost honestly.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_014.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_consensus_014.text: If we change now, we'll get a useful different display. Qiu's voice was plain. We won't learn how this rule fares through the rising interval. I don't want every method to be rescued from its worst cost just before the cost can be seen. Lin felt the criticism land close to home. She agreed to keep the rule. Qiu's unposted solo value remained visible on the private account, a piece of useful work the public method had chosen not to use.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_015.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_015.text: By the time their next independent pair agreed, the sharp rise had slowed. The board showed a sound later value. Their paired history did not contain the fastest-changing interval. Qiu's solo line lay in the gap without being promoted into a pair. Lin named the missing interval aloud. The spectators had seen the board go pending and then settle again; they could have mistaken that tidy recovery for continuous knowledge. The missing observation needed a sentence because the surface of the display no longer showed its absence.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_016.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_consensus_016.text: We cannot name the exact crest from the corroborated sequence. Su kept the private solo line distinct. Your paired calls establish several observed rises and the later lower line. Qiu's single call adds one observation during a gap, but it has not undergone this route's independent check. Bao's working record is outside your trial account. We will not import his observations merely to make your method seem more complete at the moment it became slow.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_017.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_017.text: Lin's next call ran late because her shoulder needed a longer rest against the stool. She told Su before the interval began. Qiu offered to make the solo observation while Lin rested, just as she had during the old-copy correction. Su recorded it privately. Lin did not owe the method a hurried posture in order to avoid a public gap. The limitation was part of the trial from the start. It could be measured without being treated as a personal failure to compete earnestly.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_018.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_consensus_018.text: The method asks for two available observers, Qiu said after Lin's rest. That is one of its conditions. It should not ask one observer to become two by denying her need to stop. Lin thanked her without turning the sentence into an unexpected tenderness. Qiu was making a rigorous point about the procedure, and that point was kind precisely because it remained rigorous. The method's cost belonged to its demand for two readings, not to Lin's body alone.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_019.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_019.text: The final independent set agreed after the water began falling. They checked the wet stain explicitly and described the moving edge in each card. The added condition eliminated the earlier sightline discrepancy. It also lengthened every call. Su displayed the later bounded observation and then covered the board at the closing time. The method ended with a sound current account, a corrected copied digit, a protected sightline disagreement, and several intervals in which no corroborated current display had been available.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_020.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_consensus_020.text: I still value the disagreement we caught. Lin ran her finger beside the two first cards without touching their wet ink. I also see that I would have missed the turning rise if Qiu had not kept solo notes during our gaps. I can't call those notes independently checked simply because I now want the missing interval. Qiu looked relieved by the distinction. Lin was keeping the evidence she liked and refusing to upgrade the evidence she needed in order to make her own result prettier.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_021.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_021.text: Jian asked which set she should trust. Su said the question depended on what she wanted to know. The paired cards supported the values at their stated intervals under their checks. Qiu's solo cards supported her direct observations at their own times. Neither set supplied continuous water history. Jian frowned, then said she would prefer a display that told her when it was pending. Qiu tapped the hinged cover. At least we learned to make that ordinary uncertainty visible instead of leaving it for you to guess.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_022.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_consensus_022.text: I was faster than the public rule could use. Qiu said it without grievance. That is a real loss for my work in this route. Your old-copy check supplied a real correction. If the final account names both, I can live with the method's choice. Lin nodded. She had not expected rivalry to require acknowledging unused good work, but a slow procedure could waste a rival's skill as readily as a quick one could omit a necessary check.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_023.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_consensus_023.text: The corroborated framing caught the stain disagreement before display and corrected the altered old practice digit against its source. Su gathered the cards. It produced sound paired values while missing a faster-changing interval and leaving several solo observations outside its chosen rule. Lin's shoulder rest was honored. The trial neither establishes the channel's exact crest nor certifies anyone for future flood work. We compared one practice display under one selected procedure, and its full cost will remain visible.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_024.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_024.text: The observers left while Bao continued his ordinary station work. Qiu helped fold the practice board, then stood at the rail until Lin was ready to rise. She did not pretend to be waiting for a better last look at the water. Lin appreciated the candid pause. A rival could spare her a hurried exit without being asked to spare her a difficult account. Those two forms of consideration had become easier to distinguish over the three afternoons.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_025.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_consensus_025.text: Lin carried no instrument or new authority away from the station. She carried the memory of a useful caught disagreement, a corrected false copy, and a crest their chosen method had not seen completely. Qiu carried the sharper knowledge that good solo work could remain unusable under a rule both women had freely selected. The shared account would have to respect those losses. The rivalry had not produced equal victories, but it had made each woman answer for the work her preferred method failed to use.

rival_compete_flood_bound_entry.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_entry.text: Lin selected an uncertainty-bounded display. Instead of posting one precise current value whenever possible, the practice board would show a narrow observed band and a clear time interval. When the available readings could not support even that band, Su would cover the board and show a pending notice. Qiu accepted the framing with visible doubt. A range could acknowledge uncertainty; it could also make a weak reading look prudent by drawing such a broad boundary that nothing could prove it wrong.

rival_compete_flood_bound_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_bound_002.text: Choose the band rule before the water moves. Qiu set two short strips beside the board. Otherwise you can widen the band after any inconvenient observation and call every result within expectation. Lin proposed the visible lower and upper marks of their safe sightlines during each agreed interval. Su would preserve their original range even when later readings left it. The board would claim observations within a named past interval, not enclose the river's next movement in an imagined permission.

rival_compete_flood_bound_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_003.text: The first interval gave a narrow band. Lin could see the moving surface below a darker wet mark. Qiu saw the same surface from the far rail. They named the sightlines and times. Su displayed the band as an observation of that interval, with no forecast. The public shape was less precise than Qiu's single confident number would have been, but it made the observer's margin easy to see. Pei asked whether the water really occupied two heights at once. Lin explained that the interval included movement.

rival_compete_flood_bound_004.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_bound_004.text: The range is ours, not the river's promise. Lin pointed to the times below it. The water moved between those marks while we looked. It may have moved outside them since. Qiu watched Pei's expression. He understood the explanation, then immediately asked whether the upper strip marked the worst expected rise. Qiu answered no before Lin could begin another paragraph. The band's physical resemblance to a limit had invited a prediction even though the written account explicitly refused one.

rival_compete_flood_bound_005.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_005.text: Su added observed only to the top of the board. The words helped Jian, who had been reading the times, and did little for the boy who merely looked at the strips. Lin could feel her preferred careful form becoming visually misleading. It did not need a numerical error to fail a reader. Qiu asked whether the upper strip should be less like a warning line. They moved both strips into a framed card, clearly separate from the working gauge, and preserved the first layout as a failed draft.

rival_compete_flood_bound_006.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_bound_006.text: The picture was stronger than your sentence, Qiu said. She did not sound pleased to have exposed the weakness. I nearly treated the upper strip as a threshold myself because that's what an upper strip looks like beside water. Lin nodded. The revised card was smaller and carried its times directly beside the band. A bounded account had to be honest in its shape as well as its wording. Lin could not defend the initial design by saying attentive readers would understand her intended distinction.

rival_compete_flood_bound_007.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_007.text: The next interval produced a wider observed band as the water rose faster. Su displayed it in the revised card. Qiu supplied the earliest and latest calls promptly; Lin identified the moving edge and wrote the interval. The range preserved their changing observations without selecting one number as permanently current. It also hid the order of the movement from anyone who saw only the band. A widening range might result from steady rise, oscillation, or a sightline dispute. Its apparent restraint did not carry those differences automatically.

rival_compete_flood_bound_008.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_bound_008.text: The order remains on the private card. Lin realized the weakness while answering Jian's question. That is not enough if the public band is meant to communicate the observed change. She added rising during this interval, with the same narrow scope as the numbers. Qiu asked whether they had observed continuously. They had not. Lin changed the phrase to successive calls rose. The correction made the public sentence less graceful and more exact. Her method had gained another clause because the chosen display had hidden something its viewers reasonably wanted.

rival_compete_flood_bound_009.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_bound_009.text: The first arranged disturbance is an older practice card. Su handed Jian the earlier copy, with its own clear time. Jian offered the old lower value as grounds for widening the current band downward. Qiu rejected it at once. It belongs to an earlier interval. Lin marked the copy historical and kept the current range unchanged. The bounded approach could absorb a stray old number so easily that excluding it mattered more than expanding the range around every paper someone brought to the table.

rival_compete_flood_bound_010.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_010.text: Su's next practice card had a changed digit. Lin saw a value outside the displayed band and proposed covering the board until the discrepancy could be resolved. Qiu asked whether it was a fresh observation. Jian pointed to the older time. Lin had noticed the numerical difference before the temporal difference. Her own range had captured her attention: a number outside it felt like a breach demanding action even when it did not claim to belong within the selected interval at all.

rival_compete_flood_bound_011.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_bound_011.text: I called a stop against the wrong interval. Lin looked at Su's bell hand. The altered copy still deserves checking, but it doesn't contradict our displayed band for the later observations. Su recorded a false display stop. Qiu kept the current calls moving while Lin compared the altered card with its retained source. The copied digit was indeed wrong. The correction did not retroactively justify the stop that Lin had proposed for a different reason.

rival_compete_flood_bound_012.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_012.text: For one interval the board remained covered because Su had already acted on Lin's stop request. The observers received no practice value during that interval, though Qiu made sound current calls privately. Lin could not reclaim the lost display time merely by finding a real error on the old card. The mistaken caution had a concrete cost, small and reversible but actual. Qiu's efficiency objection now referred to something that had happened: their careful frame had interrupted useful present information while pursuing an irrelevant contradiction.

rival_compete_flood_bound_013.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_bound_013.text: The old card was wrong. Qiu waited until Lin finished its correction. Your stop was also wrong for this board. Both statements fit. Lin agreed. Qiu's tone sharpened on the next sentence. I have heard people make any discovered error justify any prior alarm. Then no alarm can fail. Lin had almost done exactly that with the altered digit. Her rival's objection prevented a pleasing rescue story in which excessive caution had merely been wisdom arriving before its proper explanation.

rival_compete_flood_bound_014.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_014.text: They reopened the practice board with the next valid interval. The water was rising sharply, and the observed band widened. Lin wanted to cover it again because its upper edge now moved from card to card so quickly. Qiu asked which agreed criterion had failed. Both sightlines were clear, the calls had times, and the range contained the interval's observed marks. Speed of change made the information brief-lived. It did not by itself make their bounded past observations unknowable.

rival_compete_flood_bound_015.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_bound_015.text: I am asking the board to promise too much by fearing its age. Lin set the chalk down. We can show a past interval honestly and say when it ended. We cannot promise how long a reader will find it useful. Qiu nodded. The uncertainty route had exposed a strange form of overconfidence in caution: Lin was treating withholding as if it could prevent every possible misuse of an observation. The public blank would not carry the missing knowledge she wished she could guarantee.

rival_compete_flood_bound_016.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_016.text: Su allowed the valid range to remain through its stated interval and covered it at the scheduled update, rather than at every felt concern.
