The procedure became steadier. Qiu's prompt calls supplied the changes; Lin's band and times supplied their observational bounds. The method still spent longer making each public card than a single current call would have spent. Its value was different, and its cost remained visible even after Lin stopped adding precautionary interruptions that the agreed criterion did not support.

rival_compete_flood_bound_017.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_bound_017.text: Now the sightline changes, Su said when a gust dimpled the water against the gauge. This is the river's ordinary movement, not an arranged disturbance. The near surface flickered across two marks while the far surface remained easier to see. Lin could not call a narrow near value without guessing. Qiu's far call stayed distinct. The selected band rule required both sightlines to bound the interval, so Su marked the display pending while they observed another interval from their safe positions.

rival_compete_flood_bound_018.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_018.text: This pending interval was justified under the selected rule. Lin felt relief and immediately distrusted her pleasure in it. A legitimate stop did not erase the false one. Qiu kept her far observations on a private card. The wind eased, both sightlines became clear, and a narrow observed band returned. They reopened the board after the new interval, making no claim about the gap. The method had now withheld once for an irrelevant card discrepancy and once for an actual lost sightline.

rival_compete_flood_bound_019.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_bound_019.text: Put those stops on different lines, Qiu said. The wind stop had the condition we agreed. The old-card stop didn't. Lin did so. She could imagine a public summary that said they had prudently paused twice during uncertainty. It would be a smooth sentence and a bad account. The distinction required more care than the stops themselves. A method devoted to bounded confidence could become impossible to criticize if its author used uncertainty as a generous name for every mistake.

rival_compete_flood_bound_020.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_020.text: The falling water crossed its own wet stain during the final observations. Lin named the moving lower edge and Qiu checked it from the far rail. The band stayed narrow and properly timed. Both women had corrected the visual trap before it produced a provisional value. Su recorded the condition as observed and resolved. They had learned from the environment during the chosen afternoon without claiming that this particular check now made every gauge or future flood safe.

rival_compete_flood_bound_021.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_bound_021.text: My widest uncertainty today was in deciding what to withhold. Lin looked at the separate stop lines. The numbers were sometimes easier than the responsibility I wanted the board to carry. Qiu listened without offering comfort. Then she said the current card had become useful after Lin let its stated interval do its work. It was a precise acknowledgment, leaving the false stop and its lost interval intact. Lin found that more helpful than being told her caution had come from a good heart.

rival_compete_flood_bound_022.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_022.text: Jian read the final card correctly: observed range, fixed gauge, named sightlines, ended interval, no forecast. The boy still wanted to know whether the upper band was a warning. Qiu turned the card around and showed him where their observations had stopped. She explained that someone responsible for an actual warning would use a different source and authority. The elective display gave him information about a few measured minutes, not a rule for deciding where his family could walk.

rival_compete_flood_bound_023.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_bound_023.text: The uncertainty framing produced bounded interval cards, corrected a misleading first layout, and preserved a valid wind-related gap. Su gathered the drafts. Lin's irrelevant old-card stop withheld one useful display interval; the altered historical digit was corrected separately against its retained source. Qiu supplied sound prompt calls, including unused private calls while the board was covered. The observed band is not a flood prediction, the highest observed band is not an exact crest, and this trial gives neither woman channel authority.

rival_compete_flood_bound_024.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_bound_024.text: Qiu tied the revised band cards into their own small bundle. Lin kept the first visual layout and the false-stop note above it, where the final account could not easily forget them. The uncertainty method had remained useful, but its strongest criticism came from the rival's refusal to let precaution absorb every error. Lin had lost a particular judgment about when to stop. She had not lost the right to name a valid uncertainty, and Qiu had not denied it.

rival_compete_flood_bound_025.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_bound_025.text: I prefer your final card to your first caution. Qiu said it while Su covered the practice board for the day. Lin answered that she preferred Qiu's specific objection to the general impatience she had feared. They both smiled, tiredly. The river kept moving beneath the fixed gauge, unconcerned by their revised esteem. Their three-afternoon contest had produced a bounded display and an avoidable absence within it. Both would have to survive the warmer conversation waiting back at the loggia.

rival_compete_close_before_001.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_close_before_001.text: Back at the review loggia, Su laid the three afternoons' selected cards in order. She did not arrange them by which woman they favored. Lin's shoulder rested against the stool back, and Qiu sat rather than standing over the evidence. The rain had stopped. Water still ticked from the roof's edge, making a quieter clock than the bell had made. The rivalry no longer needed a spectator to feel real; the retained failures supplied an audience exact enough for both women.

rival_compete_close_before_002.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_close_before_002.text: The three voluntary afternoons used the free intervals we verified before the trial. Su placed their schedule beside the cards. No earlier commitment moved because you chose this branch. This work has no participant wage, prize, advance, cultivation examination or attribute reward. The facility grant remains apart from Lin's purse. The account is nine copper for space, six for purchased supplies, six for witness costs, and three unused copper returned through the facility. The sum is twenty-four, with no remainder to divide between rivals.

rival_compete_close_before_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_close_before_003.text: Qiu looked at the empty place where a prize might have sat in another sort of contest. She seemed relieved by its absence all over again. Lin had spent effort and attention, not bought an improved rank with a public disagreement. The cards belonged to a modest trial whose next use would depend on someone actually choosing to read them. That smallness did not make the afternoons trivial. It kept their real observations from becoming claims to a life neither woman had agreed to live.

rival_compete_close_before_004.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_close_before_004.text: I still want to know which method you would choose again, Qiu said. Not as a verdict over the whole three days. For the same question, with the same objects and time. Lin looked at the selected cards. Her answer differed across them. She could choose Qiu's prompt call for a clear present edge, a separated history for an object whose behavior had varied, or a targeted challenge when a concise interpretation hid a consequential assumption. None of those preferences required her to erase a loss.

rival_compete_close_before_005.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_close_before_005.text: I would choose a question before choosing the method's honor. Lin smiled at the awkward phrasing. That answer is less satisfying than being a person who always knows what care demands. Qiu said she would miss being a person who always knew what economy demanded. Then she frowned. I don't want us to make the same speech in different words merely because the final afternoon has ended. You still stop sooner than I do. I still discard details sooner than you do. We should leave that visible.

rival_compete_flood_recall.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_recall.text: Su opened the flood-reading account. The third afternoon had changed their earlier disagreements without resolving them all. Current pace, inherited evidence and bounded uncertainty had each taken different shapes beside the channel. She would read only the result of the framing they had actually selected. Lin let her hands rest empty. She had no slate to hide behind while hearing an unfavorable summary, and Qiu had no tags to straighten while deciding whether the summary gave her work its proper place.

rival_compete_flood_early_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_early_cb_001.text: You chose prompt water sampling. Qiu led a useful current display through the observed rise. Lin's second sightline caught one provisional value drawn from a wet stain before the board changed. An old-card interruption and the stain correction left gaps, so the highest observed value was not an exact crest. The changed historical practice digit stayed unresolved in this framing. Your route gained present cadence and kept an unfinished older-source question; neither result cancels the other.

rival_compete_flood_early_cb_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_early_cb_002.text: The unfinished copy bothers me more now that the board is down. Qiu looked toward Lin. I could make the fast afternoon sound complete by saying the copy didn't matter to the present display. That is true of the display and false of the whole evidence we touched. I want it left as an unresolved practice discrepancy, not dismissed as a concern belonging only to your method. Lin nodded. Qiu's unfinished work had become a shared factual boundary without becoming a new obligation.

rival_compete_flood_early_cb_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_early_cb_003.text: Your prompt calls changed what the observers could see during the rise. Lin tapped the times, not the highest value. I won't make my stain correction the whole water story. I also won't say it proves a second angle is always needed before any present call. It mattered when the falling edge met its earlier wet mark. Qiu accepted the particularity. The rival's strongest success and Lin's decisive correction could survive beside the gaps, provided neither woman demanded that the other supply a flawless ending.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_consensus_cb_001.text: You chose corroborated readings. The independent cards caught a wet-stain discrepancy before display; Lin corrected the changed old practice digit against its retained source. Comparison, historical correction and an honored shoulder rest left current gaps. Qiu's solo observations during those gaps stayed outside the selected public rule. The paired sequence did not establish an exact crest. Your route gained independently checked displayed values and a repaired old copy while leaving useful solo work unused and a faster interval incompletely observed.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_cb_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_consensus_cb_002.text: I don't want the solo cards promoted now just because they fill an embarrassing space. Qiu touched the separate bundle. I also don't want them described as useless because the rule couldn't display them. They are my observations at those times, with their own limits. Lin agreed. Qiu had given their chosen slow procedure a fair trial and retained the cost it imposed on her strength. The final account could respect that work without pretending it had received a check they never performed.

rival_compete_flood_consensus_cb_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_consensus_cb_003.text: The caught disagreement and corrected copy were real. Lin looked at the gaps between paired times. So was the turning rise we didn't see with both observers. I want to keep the method available without claiming its slower public cadence was free. Qiu nodded and asked Su to preserve the pending-display note. Lin had made the older value visibly old while a new one waited. It was a small improvement, but it belonged to this route's actual difficulty rather than to a future ideal procedure.

rival_compete_flood_bound_cb_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_bound_cb_001.text: You chose bounded interval cards. The first layout looked like a prediction and was revised. Lin's stop over an older contradictory card withheld one useful display interval; the old digit was separately corrected against its retained source. A wind-related loss of sightline justified a different pending interval. Qiu supplied prompt observations, including unused private calls while the board was covered. Your route kept honest observed ranges after revision, one avoidable absence, one justified gap, and no claim to an exact crest or future flood boundary.

rival_compete_flood_bound_cb_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_flood_bound_cb_002.text: I would have called the first range cautious and left it there if we had not watched Pei treat its upper strip as a promise. Qiu shook her head. I might then have criticized all your later ranges for that first mistake. The revision deserved its own account. Lin accepted the distinction. Qiu was holding both a false stop and a useful final display in view, refusing to let her objection become as broad and difficult to criticize as the caution she had opposed.

rival_compete_flood_bound_cb_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_flood_bound_cb_003.text: Your objection stopped me from using the altered old digit to justify the wrong alarm. Lin kept the two stop lines separate. I can thank you for that and still defend the later wind-related pending interval. Qiu answered that she expected her to defend it. A rival who abandoned a sound stop merely because she had made a false one would be easy to beat and poor to work beside. Lin heard the respect in the criticism because it named a capacity she had actually used.

rival_compete_close_after_001.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_close_after_001.text: Su finished reading and let the roof drops fill the pause. Qiu did not ask for a combined winner. Lin had expected to feel relief at that omission. Instead she felt an honest disappointment: some part of her still wanted the measured days to resolve into a name she could carry home. Qiu looked toward the same blank space on the table. Neither woman needed to announce the wish. It had been visible often enough in how quickly each had defended her preferred result.

rival_compete_close_after_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_close_after_002.text: I can keep being your rival without asking for a grand verdict, Qiu said. If we meet at another suitable trial, I will still ask what your extra check buys. She paused before adding the conditional part. That is not a booking, and you do not owe me another afternoon. I liked having an opponent who could stop my answer at a real weak point. I also found it tiring. Both sentences belong to the invitation.

rival_compete_close_after_003.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_close_after_003.text: I found you useful and tiring too. Lin looked at Qiu directly. You kept ordinary sound work from becoming the forgettable ground beneath my favorite corrections. You also made me feel as though every careful pause would have to appear in court. Qiu laughed softly. That is fair. Lin was grateful for the response, then declined to turn gratitude into agreement. She could choose how close to keep this rivalry after the trial without being required to reward Qiu's candor with friendship.

rival_compete_close_after_004.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_close_after_004.text: You may leave with a shared critique, an open competitive distance, or a cordial boundary around these three afternoons. Su closed the expense account and left the result cards open. None creates an appointment or authority. A shared critique means you tell each other one useful change you will carry away. Competitive distance means you keep the contest meaningful without seeking a private reconciliation. A cordial boundary means you let the completed trial stand and reserve your time for whatever you choose next.

rival_compete_close_after_005.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_close_after_005.text: Lin considered the three forms as carefully as she had considered the cord. She did not want to select warmth merely because the final scene of a rivalry ought to look generous. She did not want to select distance merely because an opponent had caught her at a vulnerable habit. Qiu was a capable woman with her own preferences, work beyond this yard, and no obligation to become a lesson in Lin's journey. The choice concerned their present manner of parting, which was real enough to matter.

rival_compete_close_after_006.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_close_after_006.text: If you choose a boundary, I will not call it fear. Qiu said it plainly. If you choose to keep competing, I won't call that failure to learn. If you want a shared critique, I will give one without using it to pretend we've agreed about everything. Lin felt the offer's steadiness. Qiu had become a rival she could refuse without inventing a reason to despise, and a rival she could respect without promising a future she had not chosen.

rival_compete_relation_choice.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_relation_choice.text: The cards stayed on the table as Lin made her choice. Their selected routes remained fixed; no warmer or cooler parting could alter a failed label, a delayed interval, a correct prompt call, or a useful recovered account. The three afternoons had ended. What remained available was the way Lin would speak to the woman across from her now, and whether that speech opened a modest exchange, kept the challenge at a measured distance, or closed this particular trial with a courteous farewell.

choices.text: Exchange one useful critique, retaining the disagreements.
Close these afternoons with a cordial boundary.

rival_compete_relation_shared_entry.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_relation_shared_entry.text: One change I will carry is to separate current instructions from the old evidence that explains them. Lin spoke only after choosing the shared critique. I can preserve a failure without making the next reader navigate it in order to act. That idea applies to whatever small record I choose to make next; it doesn't claim we tested every future record. Qiu nodded. Lin could hear that her own sentence still wanted to grow, and she let it end before another qualification buried the useful part.

rival_compete_close_shared_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_close_shared_002.text: One change I will carry is to judge economy at the receiving end. Qiu folded her hands on the table. A short word can hand the missing work to someone else. A quick call can still need its time, its sightline and its limit. I will not add every conceivable detail. I will try to notice when my neat answer stays neat only because the listener is doing the repair silently. Lin thanked her. The exchange had actual content rather than the appearance of reconciliation.

rival_compete_close_shared_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_close_shared_003.text: They each named a remaining disagreement as well. Lin would still favor retaining a recoverable history when behavior had varied. Qiu would still favor testing the narrow live question before charging every sound object a full history. Neither disagreement required another afternoon to be booked now. Qiu rose first and waited at the ordinary gate while Lin gathered herself. They parted with an exchanged critique and a measured respect, keeping the retained failures intact beneath the warmer form of the goodbye.

rival_compete_relation_contest_entry.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_relation_contest_entry.text: I want to leave the competition open at a distance. Lin chose the words without apology. I respect your work. I don't want to turn three afternoons into a close partnership before I know whether our questions stay useful together elsewhere. Qiu answered that she preferred the same caution about partnership, though she might call it patience rather than care. Lin smiled. Even the names of their distance could remain a small contest without making the choice hostile.

rival_compete_close_contest_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_close_contest_002.text: Then remember my clean runs when you describe the corrected ones. Qiu's voice had the edge Lin had come to recognize. I will remember your useful corrections when I describe the clean runs. If we meet under another voluntary question, we can compete over that question. Until then, this one stays finished. The conditional invitation created no calendar entry. Lin accepted it as a manner of regard, not an obligation to prove she could bear another challenge.

rival_compete_close_contest_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_close_contest_003.text: They did not exchange private advice. Each signed beside the observations she had made and the revisions she had acknowledged, leaving the method disagreements available to a later reader. Qiu departed through the courtyard gate while Lin stayed to rest before her own walk. The space between their departures felt deliberate and comfortable. Their rivalry remained active in esteem, with competitive distance and no new appointment, while the actual three-afternoon trial ended on Su's table.

rival_compete_relation_distance_entry.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_relation_distance_entry.text: I want a cordial end to this trial and no continuing challenge arranged today. Lin kept her voice level. The work was useful, and I am ready to give my remaining attention elsewhere. Qiu watched her for a moment, then nodded. She did not ask Lin to prove that elsewhere was important enough. A voluntary contest had to include the right to finish it. Lin felt the boundary become simpler as soon as she spoke it without an account defending her worth.

rival_compete_close_distance_002.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_close_distance_002.text: Then I will thank you for the three afternoons and leave the cards to say the rest. Qiu stood, smoothing neither her sleeve nor the evidence. I respect the things you caught. I disagree with some of the time you spent. I can leave both thoughts here without turning the disagreement into a claim on your next free interval. Lin thanked her in return, naming Qiu's sound economy and leaving the method question open within the completed account.

rival_compete_close_distance_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_close_distance_003.text: Qiu took her own cup to the shared kitchen and left by the outer gate. Lin stayed behind the cold rail until her shoulder rested, then rose without hurrying to make the farewell warmer. The cordial boundary preserved respect and distance together. No promised comparison waited beyond it, no abandoned wager demanded settlement, and no loss had been rewritten as victory to make the parting easy. The facility retained a completed trial whose participants were free to choose other uses for their time.

rival_compete_final.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_final.text: Su put the selected cards, failed drafts and corrected copies into the trial folder. The unused grant balance had gone back through the facility, separate from Lin's purse, and the last practice board was down. Lin had spent three freely chosen afternoons against another woman's capable method, with particular successes, errors and unfinished questions kept in their actual routes. Her fifth stage remained bounded by four pairs, and her shoulder still required ordinary care. She left the loggia ready for the shared receiving conversation.

rival_compete_blind_choice.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_blind_choice.text: Choose one blinded-instrument question, Su said. A direct reference check asks what the faces say under one known small load and repeats where an object demands it. A movement history observes approach, rest and return, spending time before the first account. Targeted challenges let each woman test one consequential assumption in the other's provisional reading. All preserve their limits. We have time for one framing, and the makers' identities will remain covered until its blind work ends.

choices.text: Use direct reference checks and repeat the objects that demand it.
Record approach, rest and return for a fuller movement history.
Challenge the consequential assumption in each provisional reading.

rival_compete_flood_choice.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_flood_choice.text: Choose the changing-water framing, Su said. Prompt sampling favors a current call and keeps older-source questions separate. Corroborated readings require two independent calls before the practice board changes, accepting the comparison delay. Bounded interval cards show an observed range and go pending when their agreed evidence fails, accepting the cost of withholding. The fixed gauge and working record remain untouched. No framing issues channel orders, grants authority, or promises a flood prediction. We are choosing this afternoon's practice display.

choices.text: Favor prompt current readings, accepting historical gaps.
Require independent corroboration, accepting a slower display.
Show bounded intervals, accepting withholding and its costs.

rival_compete_cord_common.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_cord_common.text: Su set the earlier card beside the unopened trays and made room for the new question. The previous afternoon's retained account remained available in its own right. It would neither certify the covered instruments nor disappear because the weather and objects had changed. Lin rested the chalk on the rail while Qiu checked that both women could see the pointer faces. The next choice concerned a fresh low-load observation, made with yesterday's evidence still bounded by what it had actually tested.

rival_compete_blind_common.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_blind_common.text: Su placed the instrument card beneath a dry cover and turned toward the fixed gauge. The river supplied a fresh question while the retained instrument account stayed available for inspection. Lin's cup and slate rested on her side of the cold rail. Qiu stood at the far safe sightline, sleeves secured above her hands. Bao continued his own station work. Their practice display would be chosen now, with its authority limited to the elective trial and its observations limited to this afternoon.

rival_compete_flood_common.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_flood_common.text: Su left the water cards in their observed order and closed the practice display notes. The fixed gauge belonged to its ordinary work again; the trial board had already come down. Lin and Qiu could inspect the retained account without adding observations after the agreed bell. Whatever warmth or distance they chose in parting would have no power to alter the marked intervals, corrected drafts or unfinished questions. Their remaining choice concerned the manner of this present goodbye.

rival_compete_cord_fast_match_001.speaker: rival_su_yao
rival_compete_cord_fast_match_001.text: Before the first disturbance, compare the messages under matched clean conditions. Su brought Jian inside the marked lane and gave her the empty tags. Both authors will sit behind the cold rail with the same view. Each will prepare directions for four final places; Jian will follow them. Preparation and successful reading both count toward first-answer time. I will reset outside the timed interval. We will reverse author order in the second pair, so Jian's familiarity does not always favor the same woman.

rival_compete_cord_fast_match_002.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_cord_fast_match_002.text: Qiu sat beside Lin and took a clean scrap. For the first course she wrote the origin and four destinations in a single column, with the top fixed toward the gate. She omitted a separate restart point because the clean question asked for a complete first placement. Jian followed the compact card without a question. Su recorded the time only after the fourth tag stood correctly. Qiu's method had now faced an inherited reader instead of benefiting from Qiu's own practiced hands.

rival_compete_cord_fast_match_003.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_cord_fast_match_003.text: For a comparable four-place course, Lin wrote origin, direction and the last confirmed pair beside her destination column. She intended the extra fields to remain useful if the order later changed. Jian read the whole scrap before moving, then looked between the pair note and the next destination. Her first placement was correct, with no restart. It arrived later than the placement from Qiu's card. Lin had supplied information this clean question did not require, and the reader had spent time sorting its purpose.

rival_compete_cord_fast_match_004.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_cord_fast_match_004.text: My extra fields cost preparation and reading time here. Lin said it before Su invited comment. They may help after a change, but I cannot claim that help from a clean run. Qiu nodded without smiling. The matched comparison had exposed a cost instead of proving the fields foolish. Lin still wanted them when recovery mattered. She also had a visible reason to stop presenting them as an innocent addition whose only effect was to make a record more complete.

rival_compete_cord_fast_match_005.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_cord_fast_match_005.text: Su reset two comparable courses and reversed the order. Lin authored first, using the same three-field form. Jian completed it accurately. Qiu then supplied her fixed-top destination column, and Jian completed that accurately too. Qiu's total first-answer interval remained shorter in this second pair. The repeated result did not test every possible reader or disturbance. It did establish the local comparison Lin had wanted to avoid imagining: with Jian, these clean courses and these forms, the extra recovery fields slowed a sound first answer.

rival_compete_cord_fast_match_006.speaker: rival_qiu_zhen
rival_compete_cord_fast_match_006.text: Keep the condition beside the times, Qiu said. I won these clean message comparisons. I didn't prove that a restart field is useless after the course changes. She rose from the stool and waited outside the walking lane while Su restored the original tags. Lin appreciated the precise win and felt irritated by it all the same. Qiu did not need to overstate the result to make it sting. The columns already preserved what Lin had paid and what she had gained.

rival_compete_cord_fast_match_007.speaker: narrator
rival_compete_cord_fast_match_007.text: Su kept the matched-message timings in a separate row from the direct-handling run. They measured different roles and would not be averaged into a convenient single clock score. Jian returned to the loggia with her cup. Qiu resumed tag handling; Lin resumed the receiver's slate. The original course would now meet its planned disturbance, while the clean authored comparisons stayed available as evidence of a particular rival strength. Neither woman had to pretend the next change would retroactively cancel those sound times.

rival_compete_cord_fast_match_008.speaker: lin_yue
rival_compete_cord_fast_match_008.text: Your compact card was faster for Jian on both clean comparisons. Lin watched Qiu return to the first peg. I want to see where a changed course makes that economy cost something, and I don't need to deny its current value to ask. Qiu answered that she wanted the same question. Their rivalry now had a measured first-answer difference within this selected afternoon, alongside a distinction between direct handling and authored messages that the final account would have to preserve.
